note: Every table names the ONE service that may read and write it. A table absent from this file is a build error, never a silently skipped row — completeness is the point. Owners are package names, never paths (Ruling 5).

unowned.note: Ruling 6 — no unowned tables. These six are the completeness defect: 90 of the 91 production table violations are here, and exactly one is a genuine foreign access. Until an owner is named NOBODY may touch them, which is what the model already says.
